title: AI Solutions Architect | AI Products & Consulting
summary: AI solutions architect, consultancy founder, and hands-on builder of production AI applications. Delivered 120+ GenAI applications and 90+ AI chatbots for 30+ clients across multiple industries. Builds RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and automation, with enterprise experience deploying OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini together under governance controls. Combines client-facing architecture with practical AI education through a 100+ member community and a portfolio of 100+ public AI and automation projects.
